planets.name: HIP 94235 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 94235 with a 7.71-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HIP 94235 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HIP 94235. Its orbit and size follow Zhou et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
